title: Get approval to install a cooling tower or water system
what: Get the local government's written approval before installing or substantially modifying an air-handling system, water system or cooling tower in a building.

sources.title: Health (Air-handling and Water Systems) Regulations 1994 (WA)
sources.quote: A person who proposes to install, or substantially modify, an air-handling system, water system or cooling tower in a building must make an application for that purpose to the local government and obtain the written approval of the local government

sources.title: Health (Air-handling and Water Systems) Regulations 1994 (WA)
sources.locator: s 6, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current version)
sources.quote: The Chief Health Officer may amend or cancel an approval granted under this regulation.
